query: SELECT test_script_path, tested_item_path, has_wildcard AS "has_wildcard!" FROM ci_test_reference r WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND tested_item_kind = $2 AND (has_wildcard OR tested_item_path = $3 OR tested_item_path = $4) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM script s WHERE s.workspace_id = $1 AND s.path = r.test_script_path AND NOT s.archived AND NOT s.deleted)
